outcome: abundance of Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis (B. infantis)
cohort: Infants of Asian ancestry born in Singapore.
finding: First-generation migratory status, perinatal antibiotics usage, and cesarean section birth significantly influenced the abundance and acquisition of bifidobacteria in the infant gut.
mod_finding: Cesarean section birth was associated with lower abundance and acquisition of bifidobacteria.
